At JC Custom Cabinets in Temecula, every project is a personal atelier — one master craftsman directing a singular vision. From bespoke joinery to the flawless installation of major appliances, fixtures, backsplashes, flooring, and lighting, we manage every discipline under one roof. Expect singular attention, impeccable fit and finish, and a remodel that reads like a custom piece—beautiful, purposeful, and made to endure.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS.
DO YOU OFFER CUSTOM CABINETRY?

Yes, we specialize in custom cabinetry tailored to your exact needs and style preferences. Our expert craftsmen design, build, and install custom cabinets for kitchens, bathrooms, entertainment centers, laundry rooms, and closets. Every piece is made to the highest standards, ensuring functionality and aesthetic appeal that perfectly complements your space.

DO YOU OFFER IN-HOME CONSULTATIONS?

Yes, we offer free in-home consultations to help you plan your kitchen or bathroom renovation or cabinetry needs. Call us now to schedule your appointment and get started on transforming your space.

CAN YOU WORK WITH A TIGHT BUDGET?

Yes, we can work with a tight budget by offering quality prefabricated cabinetry sourced from a trusted local manufacturer. This approach allows us to provide durable, stylish cabinets that fit your financial plan without compromising craftsmanship or design. Combining these cost-effective options with our expert installation ensures you get the best value for your kitchen or bath remodel.

DO YOU OFFER MORE THAN ONLY CABINETRY?

Yes, we specialize in comprehensive renovation services that go far beyond cabinetry. Our expertise includes full kitchen and bathroom remodels featuring custom cabinets, expertly crafted countertops, and intricate tiled floors and walls. We also handle the relocation and installation of natural gas lines, electrical wiring, and plumbing to ensure your space functions seamlessly. Additionally, we install appliances, hardware, and lighting fixtures, and provide professional flooring solutions to complete your renovation with precision and style.
